question: What products are formed when an acid neutralizes a base or an alkali?
urdu_translation: acid جب base یا alkali کو neutralize کرتا ہے تو کون سے products بنتے ہیں؟
A: Metal and hydrogen / metal اور hydrogen
B: Salt and oxygen / salt اور oxygen
C: Acid and carbon dioxide / acid اور carbon dioxide
D: Salt and water / salt اور water
correct_answer: D | Salt and water / salt اور water

question: Which equation represents the neutralization reaction given for sodium chloride formation?
urdu_translation: sodium chloride کی formation کے لیے دی گئی neutralization reaction کون سی ہے؟
A: NaCl + H₂O → NaOH + HCl / NaCl + H₂O → NaOH + HCl
B: NaOH + Cl₂ → NaCl + H₂O / NaOH + Cl₂ → NaCl + H₂O
C: NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O / NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O
D: Na + HCl → NaOH + Cl₂ / Na + HCl → NaOH + Cl₂
correct_answer: C | NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O / NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O

question: A salt is described as a chemical combination of which particles?
urdu_translation: salt کو کن particles کا chemical combination بیان کیا گیا ہے؟
A: Positive and negative ions / positive اور negative ions
B: Neutral atoms only / صرف neutral atoms
C: Positive ions only / صرف positive ions
D: Molecules without charges / بغیر charges والے molecules
correct_answer: A | Positive and negative ions / positive اور negative ions

question: What force bonds oppositely charged ions together in a salt?
urdu_translation: salt میں oppositely charged ions کو کون سی force آپس میں bond کرتی ہے؟
A: Gravitational force / gravitational force
B: Magnetic repulsion / magnetic repulsion
C: Electrostatic force of attraction / electrostatic force of attraction
D: Nuclear force / nuclear force
correct_answer: C | Electrostatic force of attraction / electrostatic force of attraction

question: From where do the positive and negative ions of a salt generally originate?
urdu_translation: salt کے positive اور negative ions عموماً کہاں سے آتے ہیں؟
A: Both ions come only from acids / دونوں ions صرف acids سے آتے ہیں
B: Positive ions come from bases and negative ions come from acids / positive ions bases سے اور negative ions acids سے آتے ہیں
C: Positive ions come from acids and negative ions from bases / positive ions acids سے اور negative ions bases سے آتے ہیں
D: Both ions come only from metals / دونوں ions صرف metals سے آتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | Positive ions come from bases and negative ions come from acids / positive ions bases سے اور negative ions acids سے آتے ہیں

question: On which two factors does the strength of electrostatic attraction between ions depend?
urdu_translation: ions کے درمیان electrostatic attraction کی strength کن دو factors پر depend کرتی ہے؟
A: Colour and physical state of the salt / salt کا colour اور physical state
B: Number of neutrons and atmospheric pressure / neutrons کی تعداد اور atmospheric pressure
C: Shape of the container and volume of water / container کی shape اور water کا volume
D: Magnitude of ionic charges and distance between the ions / ionic charges کی magnitude اور ions کے درمیان distance
correct_answer: D | Magnitude of ionic charges and distance between the ions / ionic charges کی magnitude اور ions کے درمیان distance

question: Why are ionic compounds crystalline solids under ordinary conditions?
urdu_translation: ordinary conditions میں ionic compounds crystalline solids کیوں ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Their ions are completely free to move / ان کے ions مکمل طور پر free to move ہوتے ہیں

D: They exist as separate neutral molecules only / وہ صرف separate neutral molecules کی صورت میں ہوتے ہیں
correct_answer: C | Oppositely charged ions are held in an ordered three-dimensional lattice / oppositely charged ions ordered three-dimensional lattice میں held ہوتے ہیں

question: Which change would most strongly increase the electrostatic attraction between two oppositely charged ions?
urdu_translation: کون سی change دو oppositely charged ions کے درمیان electrostatic attraction کو سب سے زیادہ بڑھائے گی؟
A: Decreasing ionic charges and increasing the distance / ionic charges کم کرنا اور distance بڑھانا
B: Keeping charges zero and increasing distance / charges zero رکھنا اور distance بڑھانا
C: Increasing only the crystal size without changing ions / ions بدلے بغیر صرف crystal size بڑھانا
D: Increasing ionic charges and decreasing the distance between ions / ionic charges بڑھانا اور ions کے درمیان distance کم کرنا
correct_answer: D | Increasing ionic charges and decreasing the distance between ions / ionic charges بڑھانا اور ions کے درمیان distance کم کرنا

question: What is a crystal lattice?
urdu_translation: crystal lattice کیا ہوتی ہے؟

B: A liquid mixture of ions / ions کا liquid mixture
C: A gas containing free atoms / free atoms والی gas
D: A regular repeating three-dimensional arrangement of ions / ions کی regular repeating three-dimensional arrangement

question: How many chloride ions surround each sodium ion in the NaCl lattice?

B: Eight / آٹھ

correct_answer: D | Six / چھ

A: Two / دو
B: Six / چھ

question: Where are the larger chloride ions located in the face-centred cubic lattice described?

question: Where are the smaller sodium ions located in the lattice description?
urdu_translation: lattice کی description میں smaller sodium ions کہاں located ہوتے ہیں؟

C: At the centres of all faces only / صرف تمام faces کے centres پر
D: Outside the crystal / crystal کے باہر
correct_answer: B | Along the edges of the cube / cube کی edges پر

question: Which statement correctly describes the local arrangement around ions in NaCl?

D: Each Na⁺ is surrounded by six Cl⁻ and each Cl⁻ by six Na⁺ / ہر Na⁺ کو six Cl⁻ اور ہر Cl⁻ کو six Na⁺ surround کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: D | Each Na⁺ is surrounded by six Cl⁻ and each Cl⁻ by six Na⁺ / ہر Na⁺ کو six Cl⁻ اور ہر Cl⁻ کو six Na⁺ surround کرتے ہیں

question: Why does the NaCl lattice form a stable ordered structure instead of a random mixture of ions?
urdu_translation: NaCl lattice random mixture of ions کے بجائے stable ordered structure کیوں بناتی ہے؟
A: Like charges strongly attract one another / like charges ایک دوسرے کو strongly attract کرتے ہیں
B: Electrostatic attraction organizes oppositely charged ions into a repeating arrangement / electrostatic attraction oppositely charged ions کو repeating arrangement میں organize کرتی ہے
C: Sodium and chloride ions have no charges / sodium اور chloride ions پر کوئی charges نہیں
D: The ions remain completely motionless before bonding / bonding سے پہلے ions مکمل motionless رہتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | Electrostatic attraction organizes oppositely charged ions into a repeating arrangement / electrostatic attraction oppositely charged ions کو repeating arrangement میں organize کرتی ہے

question: Why do ionic compounds generally have high melting points?
urdu_translation: ionic compounds کے melting points عموماً high کیوں ہوتے ہیں؟
A: A large amount of energy is needed to overcome strong electrostatic attractions / strong electrostatic attractions overcome کرنے کے لیے large amount of energy درکار ہوتی ہے
B: Their ions have no attraction / ان کے ions میں کوئی attraction نہیں
C: They contain only weak intermolecular forces / ان میں صرف weak intermolecular forces ہوتی ہیں
D: They are gases at room temperature / وہ room temperature پر gases ہوتے ہیں
correct_answer: A | A large amount of energy is needed to overcome strong electrostatic attractions / strong electrostatic attractions overcome کرنے کے لیے large amount of energy درکار ہوتی ہے

question: What happens to the attractive forces between ions during melting?
urdu_translation: melting کے دوران ions کے درمیان attractive forces کے ساتھ کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: They become infinitely stronger / وہ infinitely stronger ہو جاتی ہیں

D: They break down sufficiently to allow ions to move freely / وہ کافی حد تک break down ہو جاتی ہیں تاکہ ions freely move کر سکیں
correct_answer: D | They break down sufficiently to allow ions to move freely / وہ کافی حد تک break down ہو جاتی ہیں تاکہ ions freely move کر سکیں

question: Which combination tends to give stronger ionic attraction?

A: Lower charges and larger ion sizes / lower charges اور larger ion sizes
B: Zero charges and larger ion sizes / zero charges اور larger ion sizes
C: Equal colours and lower density / equal colours اور lower density
D: Higher ionic charges and smaller ion sizes / higher ionic charges اور smaller ion sizes
correct_answer: D | Higher ionic charges and smaller ion sizes / higher ionic charges اور smaller ion sizes

question: How do larger ionic charges affect melting point?
urdu_translation: larger ionic charges melting point کو کیسے affect کرتے ہیں؟
A: They strengthen attraction and generally raise the melting point / وہ attraction strengthen کر کے melting point عموماً raise کرتے ہیں
B: They weaken attraction and lower melting point / وہ attraction weaken کر کے melting point lower کرتے ہیں
C: They have no effect on attraction / ان کا attraction پر کوئی effect نہیں
D: They make the compound a gas / وہ compound کو gas بنا دیتے ہیں
correct_answer: A | They strengthen attraction and generally raise the melting point / وہ attraction strengthen کر کے melting point عموماً raise کرتے ہیں

question: How does a smaller ion size generally affect ionic attraction?
urdu_translation: smaller ion size عموماً ionic attraction کو کیسے affect کرتا ہے؟
A: It decreases the distance between ions and strengthens attraction / یہ ions کے درمیان distance کم کر کے attraction strengthen کرتا ہے
B: It increases the distance and weakens attraction / یہ distance بڑھا کر attraction weaken کرتا ہے
C: It removes ionic charges / یہ ionic charges remove کرتا ہے
D: It prevents lattice formation / یہ lattice formation روکتا ہے
correct_answer: A | It decreases the distance between ions and strengthens attraction / یہ ions کے درمیان distance کم کر کے attraction strengthen کرتا ہے

question: Which compound is expected to have the higher melting point, NaCl or MgCl₂?
urdu_translation: NaCl اور MgCl₂ میں سے کس compound کا melting point higher expected ہے؟
A: NaCl / NaCl

A: KCl is expected to have a much higher melting point / KCl کا melting point much higher expected ہے

correct_answer: C | KOH + HNO₃ → KNO₃ + H₂O / KOH + HNO₃ → KNO₃ + H₂O

question: After neutralization in a titration, what does the solution in the conical flask contain?

question: Why is the neutralized solution heated gently only until a thin film of crystals appears when the salt is not evaporated to dryness?
